chunks: And from him, from Ibn Muskān, from Ya'qūb al-Aḥmar, who said:

I asked him about the night prayer at the beginning of the night, so he said, 'Good is what you saw and good is what you did.' Then he said, 'Indeed, the young man sleeps much, so I command you to do it.'
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended time for performing the night prayer according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, the Imam (peace be upon him) encourages performing the night prayer early to counteract the natural tendency of youth to sleep deeply, ensuring the worship is completed before fatigue sets in. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on *muqaddimat al-ibadah* (preparatory acts) and the practical wisdom of aligning worship with human physiological rhythms to maintain consistency in *Tahajjud*. The approval highlights the importance of discipline in the early hours, a key component of spiritual refinement in Twelver Shi'ism.
